title: Assurance Envelopes for Autonomous Coding Agents: Minimum-Cost Evidence for Software Change

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Given the properties a change must preserve, its obligations, we ask which least-cost subset of the available evidence re-establishes them, and we call such a subset a task-conditioned assurance envelope.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: A prespecified synthetic benchmark of 249 instances characterizes computation: a baseline that discards the 'several pieces together' structure necessarily fails to re-derive them; every completed exact cross-check agreed with the CP-SAT optimizer; and median solve time stayed below 20 ms at 500-evidence graphs, except that graphs with many alternative derivations per target timed out at far smaller sizes, so structure, not raw size, drives difficulty.
